title: plan-atlas plan file
description: Work items, their groups and dependencies. Group status, aggregated edges and overlaps are derived by plan-atlas; never write them here.

namespace.description: Prefix other files use to reference this file's nodes: <namespace>:<id>. Defaults to the id of the single root node.

areas.description: Code areas work can touch, key → label. Overlap rules compare these.

claims.description: Statements that an item in another plan depends on one of ours. Checked against that plan when both are loaded (V9).

ref.description: An id in this file, or <namespace>:<id> in another file.

sources.description: Groups: plan files items below may cite as their source.

evidence.description: Why the status is what it is.

inferred.description: true when the status is a judgement, not stated in the plan.

kind.description: Free tag used by overlap rules, e.g. "move" for structural refactors. "release" marks a published release item (never a group); its id is <package>@<version>, e.g. sdk@2.1.0.

tag.description: Git tag of a release item, e.g. "v2.1.0". Only when kind is "release".

source.description: Where the item is defined: file and section.

links.description: Items and groups: the issues, pull requests or branches that carry this node's work. Fill only from what the plan or repository states. status --github and status --git compare them with the status.

link.description: #123 (an issue or pull request in the repository being checked), owner/repo#123, or branch:<name>.

type.description: hard: must finish first. order: planned sequence, not a block.

source.description: Required when the dependency crosses groups or files (V8).

quote.description: A short quote (≤ 15 words) from the source. Required with source.

type.description: Defaults to hard: the other plan must wait.
